findings.statement: The VaR breach is continuing and is still above the hard limit. It edged slightly lower, and the small change came entirely from position moves, with no contribution from the market data window.
The expected shortfall breach is continuing and remains above the hard limit, essentially unchanged from the prior day and slightly lower.
The volatility breach is continuing. Annualised EWMA volatility is still above the hard limit, though it eased a little from the prior day.

The largest sleeve, HiTec, remains above the warning level but below the hard limit, and its weight slipped marginally. HiTec also carries the largest share of portfolio variance, well above a quarter of the total and roughly in line with its weight.
The drawdown warning is continuing and the drawdown deepened because the portfolio had a negative return on the day, taking net asset value lower.

The backtest is in the yellow zone with more VaR exceptions than expected, and the coverage test rejects the model. The model may be understating risk, so the VaR figures should not be read as reassurance. Separately, a data-quality item on Hlth was escalated for human review as a security event, and no note text was available.
